subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Skill Bridge Method
description: A quick win: understand The Skill Bridge Method.

hook.text: A journalist transitioned to product management. Her storytelling and research skills were exactly what PMs needed.

buildup.text: Career pivots succeed when you build a bridge between your current expertise and the new field's needs.

discovery.text: Identify three skills demanded in the new field. Highlight which ones you already have. Close the gap on the rest.

twist.text: You don't need to master everything before pivoting. Having 70% of the skills plus a fresh perspective is often enough.

climax.text: Frame your transition as an asset: different backgrounds bring innovation. Your unique combo is your selling point.

punchline.text: Bridge skills. Close the gap. Frame it as strength.

quiz.question: How do successful career pivoters use their existing expertise?
options: They abandon it completely and start fresh
They build a bridge between current skills and the new field's needs
They wait until they have 100% of the new skills required
